'''August 2001 Billings tournament (26 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Billings, Montana on 26 August 2001. [[Travis Rumans]] won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2903">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-leaving-billings-8-25-01d2903/ leaving-billings-8-25-01], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 28 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-leaving-billings-8-25-01d2903/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[August 2001 Billings tournament (25 August)]].

* '''Date:''' 26 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Billings, Montana
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Travis Rumans]]
